fields.title: Narrate's eval traces say Kokoro, and the latency launcher rejects a bad rate
fields.description: `main.js`'s eval-trace writer labels traces Kokoro/Narrate instead of MOSS-Nano. `p5-latency-e2e.mjs` rejects a `--rates` value off Narrate's 0.80–2.00 grid before launching, and writes `latency-e2e.json` into its `--out` folder.
